_**User**_

I wantedb to try using the token-optimisation plugins (codebase-memory-mcp, caveman, graphify) but they could not be installed in my environment. Set up equivalent token/context management using built-in Cursor features and project files instead. No application code.

1) Create .cursorignore excluding from AI context/indexing: target/, build/, .gradle/, node_modules/,
   .next/, dist/, coverage/, *.log, .specstory/ (history is for humans, not agent context),
   *.lock, package-lock.json. Do NOT exclude spec/, docs/, .cursor/, backend/src, frontend/src.

2) Create .cursor/rules/context-management.mdc (alwaysApply: true):
   - Work one task at a time; don't read or modify files outside the current task's scope
   - Use codebase search and docs/codebase-map.md to locate code before opening files;
     never read whole directories speculatively
   - Read only the spec/ files relevant to the current task
   - Show diffs or changed sections only; never re-print unchanged files
   - Ask before touching more than ~5 files or doing large refactors
   - After finishing a task that adds/moves/renames classes or components, update docs/codebase-map.md

3) Create .cursor/rules/concise-output.mdc (alwaysApply: true) — our own lightweight
   replacement for caveman, applying ONLY to chat replies:
   - No greetings, preamble, restating my question, or offers to do more
   - No narration of what you're about to do; do it, then summarise in a few lines
   - Use short bullet summaries of what changed, not prose essays
   - Files written to spec/, docs/, README.md and code comments must still use complete,
     professional English

4) Create docs/codebase-map.md: a short index (module → purpose → key files) that the agent keeps
   updated. For now it only lists the current folders. This acts as persistent project memory.

5) Create docs/token-optimisation.md explaining: that the suggested plugins couldn't be installed
   (tooling/network restriction), and what replaced each one:
   - codebase-memory-mcp → Cursor built-in codebase indexing + docs/codebase-map.md
   - caveman → concise-output.mdc rule
   - graphify → Mermaid diagrams in spec/ + codebase-map.md
   Plus practices: .cursorignore, new chat per phase/task, @-mentioning specific files,
   and reusable /commands instead of retyping long prompts.

Then run /log-prompt  (Phase: Token Optimisation) and note in the Outcome that plugins were
unavailable and built-in alternatives were used.
